runtimeDifference: The call board for every caller; iPhone board follows the App's own audio (build 46); a refused conversation record is dropped at once and remembered; phone board keeps the last lines of the conversation. Phone board no longer swings between pages; one page per title; a four-line caption strip. Phone real-time feel: V's words on an empty page, the lesson page drawn pale and inked as spoken, earlier drawing, a caption strip that really shows four lines. The board follows cues the illustrator writes (clause numbers), not word matching; one line under a phone's page; pictures for things that can be seen. Gallery pictures whole and large across the page; pages drawn smaller fit the panel; pictures open large on tap. A gallery drawn again keeps the pictures that were found; a refused picture search is asked again. Picture searches the image search answered are no longer thrown away; no Pokemon logo from a list article. A call records why it ended (and what the voice service said when it ended the session itself); picture search tries past dead links. Pictures of a page are searched at once on the Brave Search plan; a gallery no longer loops its layout, and a board piece that fails to draw no longer blanks the call page. What V makes in a call goes up on the board (a sketch, the picture, the video in the picture's frame) and V is told what is on the caller's screen; found photographs and V's own image can be the reference; a video's script is rewritten by a director's pass; places V talks about are ringed on the page's photographs; one rule for what V does itself and what goes to the backend.
